## Functions

### `composeRealmForgeDoorHardware(intent, source)`

Finish an already composed @2 mechanism package. Actuator axes and pivots are assembly coordinates at closed rest, so runtime applies the leaf's actual rigid transform before its transient handle, spring bolt and deadbolt motion.
